## What & why

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Refactor (no behavior change)
- [ ] Docs only
- [ ] Build / CI / tooling

## Checklist

- [ ] Started with a failing test (TDD), or explained below why tests don't apply
- [ ] `pnpm turbo run lint typecheck test build` passes locally
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/`, `DESIGN.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`) where behavior changed
- [ ] No machine-absolute paths or secrets committed
- [ ] Adheres to `DESIGN.md` (not in conflict with a locked decision or anti-goal)
